snippet.title: PILLARS PARTY — Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Ridiculous weapons, unpredictable gadgets, and a very long way down. 💥

⭐ Wishlist PILLARS PARTY on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5579720/

Battle your friends atop towering pillars in this chaotic multiplayer party game! Send your rivals flying, escape the closing storm, and fight to be the last one standing.

🧨 Turn the tables with unexpected weapons and gadgets.
🎙️ Hear your friends panic with proximity voice chat.
🌋 Battle across four arenas and customize your match rules.
👑 Pick your animal, personalize your look, and celebrate with a victory dance.

Bring your friends. Watch your step.

Coming soon to Steam. Developed by Wobbly Games.

Who would fall first in your friend group? 👇

#PillarsParty #PartyGame #Multiplayer #IndieGame #steam
